cases.sentence: Моисей с израилетянами воспели ___ эту песню.
cases.translation: Moses and the Israelites sang this song to the Lord.
cases.explain: The verb воспеть (to sing to someone) takes its addressee in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Коня и его всадника бросил он в ___.
cases.translation: The horse and its rider he threw into the sea.
cases.explain: The preposition в expressing motion into takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Ты приведешь и поселишь их на ___.
cases.translation: You will bring them in and settle them on the mountain.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.translation: Your right hand, O Lord, has shattered the enemy.
cases.explain: The direct object of the transitive verb сокрушить takes the accusative; for an animate noun it equals the genitive form.

cases.translation: Who among the gods is like you, O Lord?
cases.explain: The preposition из governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Своей силой ты его направишь к своему святому ___.
cases.translation: By your strength you will guide him to your holy dwelling.
cases.explain: The preposition к governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Женщины с ___, танцуя, пошли за ней.
cases.translation: The women, dancing with tambourines, went out after her.
cases.explain: The preposition с in the sense of 'together with' governs the instrumental case.

cases.translation: Moses led the Israelites on from the Red Sea.
cases.explain: The preposition от governs the genitive case.

reading.ru: Три дня они шли по пустыне, не находя воды.
reading.question: How long did they travel in the wilderness without finding water?
reading.explain: The text says 'Три дня они шли по пустыне, не находя воды' (three days they went in the wilderness finding no water).

reading.ru: Придя в Мару, они не могли пить воду, она была горькой.
reading.question: Why could they not drink the water at Marah?
reading.explain: The text says the water 'была горькой' (was bitter).

reading.ru: Моисей взмолился к Господу, и Господь показал ему кусок дерева.
reading.question: What did the Lord show Moses when he cried out?
reading.explain: The text says the Lord 'показал ему кусок дерева' (showed him a piece of wood).

reading.ru: Моисей бросил его в воду, и вода стала пригодной для питья.
reading.question: What happened after Moses threw the wood into the water?
options: The water became fit to drink
reading.correct: The water became fit to drink
reading.explain: The text says 'вода стала пригодной для питья' (the water became fit to drink).

reading.ru: Они пришли в Ерим, где было двенадцать источников воды и семьдесят пальм, там они расположились лагерем у воды.
reading.question: What did they find at Elim?
options: Twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees
A dry desert with no water
reading.correct: Twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees
reading.explain: The text says at Elim there were 'двенадцать источников воды и семьдесят пальм' (twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees).

reading.question: What does the song declare about the Lord's reign?
options: The Lord will reign for a season
The Lord will rest from ruling
The Lord will depart from the people
reading.explain: The text says 'Господь будет царствовать навеки' (the Lord will reign forever).
